content:
Dear all,

We are pleased to announce a 3-day workshop entitled Formalising Algebraic Geometry in Lean and aimed primarily at PhD students. It will take place at Heidelberg University from 19 to 21 November, 2025.

The goal of the workshop is to provide an opportunity for graduate students to deepen their understanding of both Lean and Algebraic Geometry within a collaborative and friendly atmosphere. There will be one invited talk per day and, the rest of the time, participants will team up and work on formalisation projects designed by our three guest speakers.

Further details are available here.

PhD students interested in formalising mathematics in Lean, particularly algebraic geometry, are invited to apply for the workshop by sending an email to lean-workshop@mathi.uni-heidelberg.de before October 10th. We recommend having a good knowledge of algebraic geometry and some prior experience with Lean (see the workshop's webpage for references you can consult).

In your application email, please provide the following information:

  • A short motivational statement (max. 200 words);
  • Your mathematical background and current activity;
  • The name of a person we can contact for a reference.

Although the workshop is primarily aimed at PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and advanced master's students are welcome to apply.

Funding for accommodation and travel is limited. Please indicate if you would like to apply for partial funding.

Feel free to share this information with other students who may be interested!

Best wishes,
Judith Ludwig and Florent Schaffhauser
